# Cully v0.12.0

Cully now forwards native agent commands and supports dragging the panel divider.

- Help, version, MCP management, authentication, Codex exec/review and Claude/Cursor print commands run with native streams and exit status. Pipes and redirected output no longer require an interactive terminal. Interactive coding and resume/fork sessions keep the panel.
- Drag the divider up to expand Cully or down to collapse it to one row. The agent PTY resizes, and refreshes respect your chosen height. Smaller windows retain usable agent space.
- In Warp, press Ctrl+\ to enable dragging; press it again or Esc to restore host scrolling.
- Use CULLY_NO_PANE=1 to pass any invocation directly to its executable. Native unsupported commands still return the native error.
- Website validation uses shared limits and rejects unsafe LinkedIn profile imports.

Upgrade: install v0.12.0 and reopen the Cully wrapper to load the new command routing and divider controls. No new database migration is required.
